$comment: L3 illegal actions (initial 6) plus extension point. Executing these is an implementation error, not a warning. Source: §4.4 / E2 lock-script rules.

actions.description: Renumber scenes after lock. OMITTED numbers are never recycled.
Reuse an OMITTED sceneStableId or scene_code.
Overwrite an object addressed as latest. latest is not a legal dependency.
Approve an exception without the authority named on the intent.
Silently shorten, reflow, or alter copy to make a layout fit.
Change picture after picture lock without a change order.

extension_point.description: Additional forbidden actions MUST be registered in L0 (domain delivery, kind attribute_value, parent forbidden_action) before they appear here.
